Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Oh, hello...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Och, ahoj...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Promiň, teď nemůžu.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Ooooohhh! At last, you wake me from my slumber.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ooooohhh! Konečně mě probouzíš z mého spánku.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: How was that? Did I sound all scary and impressive?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Tak co, jaké to bylo? Znělo to dost strašidelně a působivě?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Yes, very nice performance.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ano, moc pěkný výkon.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: I give it a 7 out of 10.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Dávám ti tak 7 z 10.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Terrible. I wasn't scared OR impressed.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Hrozné. Vůbec jsi mě nevyděsil ani neohromil.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Aw, thanks.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Jé, díky.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: So here's the deal. I'm the Guardian of Expression, yadda yadda yadda.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Takže se věci mají takhle. Jsem Strážce výrazu, bla bla bla.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: I'm also the last thing standing between you and the Kingdom of Oublié.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Jsem také to poslední, co stojí mezi tebou a královstvím Oublié.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: But you're not getting past unless you complete my riiiiddles! Heh-heh!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ale dál se nedostaneš, dokud nevyřešíš moje hááádanky! Che-che!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Please, Guardian. {PlayerName} is the Legendary Adventurer. I know it.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Prosím tě, Strážci. {{PlayerName}} je legendární dobrodruh. Já to vím.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Captain Hook's after someone. And as long as we're stuck here, she's in danger. You have to let us pass now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Kapitán Hook po někom jde. A dokud tu trčíme, je ta dotyčná v nebezpečí. Musíš nás hned nechat projít.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Soooorry, Meg. You know the rules. You want past? You complete my riddles.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Smůůůla, Meg. Znáš pravidla. Chceš dál? Musíš vyřešit moje hádanky.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Good luck.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Hodně štěstí.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Oh, that's not good enough. I'll have to keep practicing.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Aha, tak to nestačí. Budu muset ještě trénovat.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Wow, haven't you ever heard of CONSTRUCTIVE criticism? YEESH!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Páni, už jsi někdy slyšel o KONSTRUKTIVNÍ kritice? No teda!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: You did it. You really did it.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Dokázal jsi to. Skutečně jsi to dokázal.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: You completed my riddles. There's only one question now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Vyřešil jsi mé hádanky. Teď už zbývá jen jediná otázka.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Do you believe that you're the Legendary Adventurer?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Věříš ty sám, že jsi oním legendárním dobrodruhem?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Yes. I only wish I could remember more about my adventures here.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ano. Jen si přeju, abych si na svá zdejší dobrodružství pamatoval víc.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Who else could it possibly be?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Kdo jiný by to tak mohl být?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: I don't know. It seems so long ago now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Nevím. Už je to tak dávno.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Keep adventuring. You're bound to discover more of the past.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Nepřestávej s dobrodružstvím. Určitě z minulosti odhalíš víc.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: On the next island, you'll find <Lore>the mysterious Kingdom of Oublié</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Na dalším ostrově najdeš <Lore>tajemné království Oublié</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: A friend from the past should be waiting for you there, in the <Lore>Grand Garden</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Měl by tam na tebe čekat přítel z minulosti, přímo v <Lore>Velké zahradě</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Then I'd better sail on fast.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: V tom případě raději rychle popluju dál.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Who is this friend?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Kdo je ten přítel?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Just be careful. It seems a certain pirate may have gotten there first.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Jen buď opatrný. Zdá se, že jistý pirát tam možná dorazil dřív.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: You may face some <Lore>magical mayhem</Lore> before you find your friend!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Než svého přítele najdeš, možná budeš muset čelit troše <Lore>magického chaosu</Lore>!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: Oh, where's the fun in simply telling you?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ach, kde by byla ta zábava, kdybych ti to prostě prozradil?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: I'll just say you've had many darling adventures together.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Řeknu jen tolik, že jste spolu prožili mnoho milých dobrodružství.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: My thoughts exactly. You're sure to remember. You just have to keep exploring.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Mluvíš mi z duše. Určitě si vzpomeneš. Jen musíš dál prozkoumávat okolí.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.en: But who else could it be, silly? You just have to keep exploring and you're sure to remember.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Expression/Guar.cz: Ale kdo jiný by to mohl být, ty popletko? Stačí dál prozkoumávat a určitě si vzpomeneš.
